idea-plugin.name: MybatisLogFormatSQL
idea-plugin.description:
MybatisLogFormatSQL formats MyBatis log output into executable SQL.

Select MyBatis log text in any editor, right-click, and choose MybatisLogFormatSQL to see the SQL with all ? placeholders replaced by their typed SQL-safe literal values.

action.description: Parse MyBatis log and format the SQL with parameters filled in
